# BLXCodes

BLXCodes publishes working Roblox promo codes for popular experiences.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://blxcodes.com/): Featured games and search
- [Codes hub](https://blxcodes.com/codes/): Browse and search all game code lists
- [Blog](https://blxcodes.com/blog/): Guides on redeeming Roblox codes
- [Sitemap](https://blxcodes.com/sitemap-index.xml)
- [RSS](https://blxcodes.com/rss.xml)

## Notes for agents

- Prefer game pages under `/codes/{slug}/` for code lists.
- Treat expired codes as historical; active codes are the primary answer.
- Site language is English (`en`).
- Do not invent codes; only use listed active codes on each page.
